description: This Java class defines a custom JPanel subclass that manages MouseListener instances, allowing addition, removal, and clearing of mouse listeners and child components.

classes.name: JPanelWithListener
classes.description: A custom JPanel that keeps track of added MouseListeners for easier management, including bulk removal of listeners and children.

methods.name: JPanelWithListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes JPanel with a specified layout manager.

methods.name: addMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to add a MouseListener and keeps track of it in an internal list.

methods.name: removeMouseListener
methods.description: Overrides the method to remove a MouseListener and updates the internal list accordingly.

methods.name: removeAllMouseListeners
methods.description: Removes all MouseListeners that have been added through this class.

methods.name: removeAllChildrenAndListeners
methods.description: Removes all child components and all tracked mouse listeners.
